claims.statement: R4 started from 07540d01 with 70/70 immutable R3 artifacts present and 0 missing.
claims.limitation: A commit is a hand-off point, not proof that every future run used this tree.

claims.statement: Historical R3 passes are B0 5/6, E0 1/6, E1 3/6. The rescored task outcome is B0 5/6, E0 1/6, E1 3/6; E1 vs B0 has both 3, neither 1, E1-only 0, B0-only 2. Mechanism exposure is reported separately.
claims.limitation: The rescore is a re-reading of the same 18 cells, not a new benchmark. It does not change the historical score.

claims.statement: Across 18 pilot cells there are 67 recall/search calls; 53 results are shadowed by a later fold; 51 do not carry the payload verbatim into the next request (24 marker-only, 20 invisible-after-fold, 12 no-following-request); 9 are visible and 2 are inferred equivalent.
claims.limitation: Visibility is the exact toolCallId/content at the next primary request. A checkpoint paraphrase without an exact substring is not counted as equivalent.

claims.statement: Of the 8 failed EF cells, 7 lose the exact task source; 7 of them make no write. None of the 4 passing EF cells lose it (0 with loss).
claims.limitation: Exact prompt absence is not proof that no paraphrase existed; the artifact path and checkpoint text are reported separately.

claims.statement: T16 E0 carries 5 open failures (2 duplicate signatures, 91.2% of checkpoint chars); T16 E1 carries 9 (4 duplicate, 32.1%).
claims.limitation: The final checkpoint is the only checkpoint stored verbatim; the join from anchor to tool/path is inferred and can be unknown.

claims.statement: Character-level context balance is B0 -89947, E0 826954, E1 35166; repeated recall 16; recall payloads re-folded 51; exact-task requests lost 45.
claims.limitation: These are characters, not provider tokens. R3 has no per-step TokenMeter snapshot; the E0 positive balance is a research signal, not a billing result.

claims.statement: The pre-registered rules select active-task-delivery (contract only, not wired). The offline simulation adds 1238 exact prompt chars across 7 failed cells, bounded to two deliveries per cell.
claims.limitation: A correlation in 18 cells is not a causal effect. The simulation does not prove the model would act on the replayed source.

claims.statement: The budget-sensitivity design has 36 cells (6 tasks x 3 arms x 2 budgets), validated as 36 unique combinations with balanced blocks; executionAuthorized is false.
claims.limitation: A design is not an authorization. The proposed envelope is an estimate from R3, not a spend approval.

claims.statement: The runnable manifest is frozen at SHA-256 3411c1630edd50505ec549b71938996e1cb555403f8bf9f81dbc66d7feccc827 with 36 cells; authorization granted=false; preflight ready-for-authorization (26/26 checks).
claims.limitation: A frozen manifest and a passing preflight are not a live authorization; providerCalls is 0 and executionAuthorized is false.

claims.statement: No product candidate is proposed; Deployment Hold is true; expandTo72 is false; the research candidate remains unwired.
claims.limitation: The decision is bounded by one model, one route, one machine and a step-limit-censored 8-step lane.

claims.statement: The zero-live audit scanned 14 R4 scripts, found 0 provider/live entry points and 0 R4 campaign artifacts; providerCalls is 0.
claims.limitation: The audit checks the R4 scripts and output directories; it is not a network monitor for the whole machine.

method: Each claim names its artifact, SHA-256, commit and limitation. A missing artifact stops generation.
